name: Barbell squat

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Sit your hips back and down

phases.name: bottom
phases.cue: Thighs just below level, chest up

phases.name: stand
phases.cue: Drive through your whole foot to stand

formTips: Rest the bar on your upper back, not your neck, and grip it just outside your shoulders
Stand with your feet about shoulder-width, toes turned out a little
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down
Let your knees travel forward in line with your toes
Go until your thighs are at least level, then drive up through your whole foot
commonMistakes: Rounding the lower back at the bottom
Letting the chest drop so the bar drifts forward
